tool_input.command: cd . 2>/dev/null; D=.shop/work/i55/runs/work-queue; find $D/5-integrate/drafts -type f | head -50; ls $D/*; git status --short | head; ls spec spec/capabilities

D=.shop/work/i55/runs/work-queue/5-integrate; cat $D/drafts/round-2/gate.md; cat $D/result.json; cat $D/drafts/round-2/writer.reply.md | head -30; for c in supervision work-queue; do echo == $c; diff spec/capabilities/$c.md $D/drafts/round-2/spec/capabilities/$c.md; done

cd . ; grep -o '^- \[r[0-9]*\]' spec/capabilities/work-queue.md | tr -d '[]- ' | sort -V | tail -3; grep -o '^- \[r[0-9]*\]' spec/capabilities/supervision.md | tr -d '[]- ' | sort -V | tail -3; head -12 spec/capabilities/work-queue.md; grep -n "r23\|r59\|r105\|r213\|r212" spec/capabilities/*.md | cut -c1-160; diff <(sed -n 1,200p spec/capabilities/work-queue.md) .shop/work/i55/runs/work-queue/5-integrate/drafts/round-2/spec/capabilities/work-queue.md | cut -c1-200

python3 - <<'E'
p='spec/capabilities/work-queue.md'
s=open(p).read()
old=[l for l in s.split('\n') if l.startswith('- [r23]')][0]
new="- [r62] **When** a `work` command's change makes it true that an initiative has at least one work-item that is `green`, that every work-item of it is `green` or `withdrawn`, that every capability-proposal of it is `formulated` or `withdrawn` and that every request kept in this context whose asker is this context and that names the initiative is `delivered`, that command shall set the initiative's status to `done`."
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace("retired: [r2, r3, r11, r16, r17, r18, r33, r34, r35]","retired: [r2, r3, r11, r16, r17, r18, r33, r34, r35, r23]")
s=s.replace("- r23: a request names","- r62: a request names")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
git diff --stat; scripts/model check --limit 100000 2>&1 | tail -3; scripts/model decisions 2>&1 | tail -1; git status --short
